tagline.en: A novel-view-synthesis model from Meta (FAIR) — render a scene from new camera viewpoints.
tagline.zh: Meta(FAIR)推出的新视角合成模型——从全新相机视角渲染场景。

en: LagrNVS is a novel-view-synthesis model from Meta's FAIR research group. Given a scene, it renders how that scene would look from camera viewpoints you did not originally capture, which makes it useful for 3D scene rendering and camera-path playback.

In WorldFoundry it runs through an in-tree adapter that drives the upstream inference command, taking your scene and a target camera path and producing the synthesized views. The published checkpoint is gated, so access requires the appropriate credentials.
zh: LagrNVS 是 Meta FAIR 研究团队推出的新视角合成模型。给定一个场景,它能渲染出该场景在你原本未拍摄的相机视角下的样子,因而适用于 3D 场景渲染与相机路径回放。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过一个内置适配器运行,驱动上游的推理命令,以你的场景与目标相机路径为输入,产出合成视角。已发布的 checkpoint 受访问限制,需要相应凭据才能获取。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you have a captured scene and want to render it from new camera angles or along a camera path — for example generating fly-through views the original capture never contained.
whenToUse.zh: 当你已有一个拍摄的场景,并希望从新的相机角度、或沿某条相机路径渲染它时可以使用——例如生成原始拍摄中并不存在的穿越视角。

notFor.en: The checkpoint is gated, so you need a Hugging Face token with access; missing token or checkpoint access is reported at inference time. Running the full path requires a CUDA GPU.
notFor.zh: 该 checkpoint 受限,你需要具备访问权限的 Hugging Face token;缺少 token 或访问权限会在推理时报出。运行完整路径需要 CUDA GPU。
